title: Extinction
paragraphs: “Bubu!”

After eating Father’s cooking, everyone, including the sister and the slaves, was having a lively conversation. The sister was holding the little flag tightly as if it were precious. By the way, that line just now was from Keel.
“Raphtalia-chan…”
Her friend placed a hand on her shoulder and nodded.
“Well then, I guess that’s it. Everyone, make sure to eat up and get energized for tomorrow.”
“Yeah!”
“Bubu!”
At that moment, Keel seemed to be shouting, “I’ll do my best!” The sister, no longer forcing a smile, looked around at everyone with a genuine smile that came from the heart.
“Naofumi-sama, thank you.”
“It’s fine. This is about all I can do right now.”
“Yes… Let’s do our best from now on, Raphtalia-chan.”
“Y-Yeah.”
“If you don’t want to fight, that’s okay too.”
The sister nodded hesitantly at Father’s words. There was still a gap between this version of her and the image I had of her, and I couldn’t shake off that feeling of unease.

And so, that day came to an end. Of course, Father also made sure to feed Yuki-chan and the others with care. The sister’s night crying was still severe, but with Father and her friend sleeping beside her, she finally calmed down.
“So, this is the Dracia Mountains…”

In a clearing that looked like a mountain campsite, Father shared his impression. Before entering the mountains, he had handed over the letter entrusted to him by the Queen at the mountain gate. The gatekeeper allowed us to pass. After walking through the campsite and passing through the rows of stalls, we followed the path that led us closer to the main hotel. There were other lodgings as well, but we would be staying here.
“Welcome, Heroes of the Four Holy Weapons and your companions.”

Oh? In front of the castle… there’s a guide just like the one we saw on Cal Mira Island. I believe there was one in the Nosferatu Great Forest as well. Though the afFilo-tanted country seems different, as they’re not wearing the Melromarc military uniform, their mannerisms are identical. There’s something off about the flag.
“I am Count Lugal, entrusted with the management of this Dracia Mountain region.”
“Uh… okay…”
“Nice to meet you.”
“Pleased to meet you.”

In the first world, Father handled all the negotiations, but this time, I and Fiancée were also present. Fiancée curtsied by lightly grasping the hem of her skirt, acting as if she were in sales mode. She might be trying to show off her elegance, but I’m not so easily impressed.
“Pii!”

Sakura-chan chirped while sitting on Fiancée’s head. Ren and Itsuki? They’re completely out of it, slumped down with the slaves after getting motion sickness from the carriage. Right now, the only ones who seem fine are me, Father, and Fiancée.
“Please take care of us from now on.”
“Ah… likewise.”
“Count Lugal, I’d appreciate it if you could refrain from mentioning the Four Holy Heroes. There are some important matters at hand.”
“Oh, I see. My apologies. How should I address you then?”
“On paper, I’m listed as the representative, so—”
“Then, shall I refer to you as Princess Melty’s party?”
“There’s no need to use ‘princess.’ That’s fine.”
“Understood. I will proceed accordingly.”
And so, we officially became a group that came here incognito to level up.
“Well then, allow me to begin by sharing the history of the Dracia Mountains with you.”
This is exactly like Cal Mira Island!
It was the same in the Nosferatu Great Forest!
Do these people have some kind of illness that compels them to act as tour guides? Well, maybe it’s just part of their job.
“We didn’t come here for sightseeing! We already know how things work, so can’t we just get moving?”
“Come on now… there might be some things we need to know, so let’s hear them out.”
Father gently calmed me down, signaling to be patient. Well, if Father says so, there’s no helping it.
“Long ago, the legendary Four Holy Heroes trained their bodies here—”

This sounds like something I can completely tune out. I mean… it’s almost the same as what they said at Cal Mira Island. And near the castle entrance, I can see some familiar statues. Yes, those statues of the legendary monsters who supposedly pioneered this land, wearing Santa hats. As I was looking at those statues, the guide noticed and began explaining.
“Oh? I see you’ve noticed. Those are the legendary native pioneers of this land—Peckle, Usauny, Risuka, and Inurt.”
“I know about them. There are similar statues on Cal Mira Island and in the Nosferatu Great Forest.”
Is there some deeper meaning to the fact that these places share the same legend? Why are the so-called native pioneers always from the same species? It’s a mystery I can’t wrap my head around.
“By the way, there’s a legend that says the names were given by the Four Holy Heroes.”
“Wow… their naming sense is questionable.”
“I’ve heard that many demi-human species in this world were also named by the Four Holy Heroes. Like Hakuko and Shusaku.”
“I’d really like to see the faces of those heroes. Couldn’t they have come up with something better?”

Huh? Somehow, I feel like I can hear someone saying, “You’re one to talk,” in response to Father’s comment. But I believe in Father’s sense. After all, he was the one who named Yuki-chan and the others. And more importantly, he’s the one who named the noble Filo-tan. There’s no way Father could be wrong.
“They say the creatures were friendly with the heroes, and the heroes named them after the closest animals they could think of from their own world.”
“Penguin, rabbit, squirrel, and dog, huh? So, are there creatures like that in this mountain range?”
“No, after completing their pioneering, they departed for new lands. No one has seen them since.”
“Extinct?”
“The truth is unknown.”
“Hmm… is this some kind of mystery? According to Motoyasu, there’s a similar legend on Cal Mira Island…”
“Filo-tan mentioned that they looked delicious.”
Father glanced at me and then nodded at something.
“So they were driven to extinction after being devoured by Filolials…”
That sounds rather outrageous, but I’ll let it slide. As expected, there’s a monument next to the statues.
“What’s that?”
“It’s an inscription. Heroes can learn unique magic from it.”
“Huh… that reminds me of similar monuments I’ve seen in games before.”
“By the way, if you can’t understand the magic language, you can’t read it.”
“Then it’s useless. Ren, Itsuki, and I can only use the magic granted to us by the orbs the Queen provided… meaning we’ve only learned the predetermined spells.”

Now that I think about it, before leaving, the Queen provided orbs that enabled Father and the others to use magic. But they only learned basic ‘Fast’ spells, and while they can now sense magic, they can’t read the characters. Since understanding the language and having sufficient training is required, using complex magic instantly is impossible.
“That’s true.”
I approached the monument to search for the inscriptions. As expected, they were there. Since there was a similar monument in the Nosferatu Great Forest, I had anticipated this.
“If Motoyasu deciphers it, will we be able to use magic?”
“Impossible. The meaning of magic language changes depending on the person reading it, and you have to start by sensing the magic itself. It’s not that simple.”
“Yes. To learn magic, one must be able to read, write, and sense magic. It’s difficult for the current heroes to read it…”
“Ah… you’re right. All we know is how to recite the set words.”
“During our stay, I can teach you the script. If things go well, you might be able to learn it.”
“That would be nice.”
As we talked, I continued deciphering the inscriptions.
“This… seems to be a spell called ‘Fast Absorb.’ Based on the pattern, Father’s would be Aura, Itsuki’s would be Down, and Ren’s would be Magic Enchant.”
Looks like it’s a basic-level spell. Now that I think about it, the inscription in the Nosferatu Great Forest mentioned Dryfa.
